title: Langur or macaque?

scenes.headline: Langur: black face, long limbs
scenes.body: Black face and ears framed by pale fur, and a tail longer than the body.

scenes.headline: Macaque: brownish face, sturdy build
scenes.body: This one is from Indonesia. Macaques are robust, with arms and legs about the same length.

scenes.headline: The snack test
scenes.body: Macaques stuff extra food into cheek pouches. Langurs digest leaves in large, complex stomachs.

caption:
Two monkeys you'll meet on Indian trails, and how to tell them apart.

Langurs are mainly leaf-eaters; macaques are omnivores that eat fruit, seeds, insects and much more.

Source: Animal Diversity Web; Britannica. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Split-screen hook then one clue each, ending on a behavioural tell. Relevant to our day trails; macaque shown is honestly labelled as an Indonesian species.
